description: Free. Envelop's cloud executor runs a manager on a strategy as its OPERATOR — allocate, recenter, move, claim, reinvest, never withdraw — for owners who cannot run the local envelop-mcp-lp server (claude.ai chat, a phone, any agent with only this URL). Returns the operator address the owner allows, the chains, the price (each sent operation: its gas × 1.5, at least a per-chain minimum), top-up limits, the mandate defaults and the conditions (credit is per manager and not refunded).
